title: promoteSuggestionOnMain does two independent on-main commits (issue file, then …
description:
promoteSuggestionOnMain does two independent on-main commits (issue file, then pen-line removal). If the process dies or the pen-removal commit is lost between the two, the fingerprint stays in the pen and a manual re-promote would file a duplicate issue (the embedded suggestion-fingerprint line prevents auto-review re-dedup, but not manual re-promote). Acceptable given pushMainBestEffort semantics; a note or a single-commit combine would be more robust.

Source: cam/issue-285
Review round: 1
Location: src/commands/suggestions.ts:502

suggestion-fingerprint: b241d5cbedc6

acceptanceCriteria: promoteSuggestionOnMain files the new issue JSON and removes the promoted line from scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl in a SINGLE atomic on-main commit; there is no intermediate main state where the issue exists but the pen line remains.

The single commit re-derives the allocated issue id inside the compare-and-swap loop on every attempt (collision-free under concurrent filers), preserving the current allocateId = max-id-on-main + 1 guarantee.
A process death or lost push after the (now single) commit cannot leave the fingerprint in the pen with a filed issue; either both land or neither does.
Existing suggestions.test.ts assertions are updated: the promote path now asserts ONE commit-tree call (was two: issueSha + penSha); all other promote/dismiss tests stay green.
The embedded suggestion-fingerprint line in the filed issue is preserved (auto-review re-dedup still works).
spec.scope: Refactor promoteSuggestionOnMain (suggestions.ts:473-546) so the issue-file write and the pen-line removal land in one commit-tree commit. Thread the dynamically-allocated issue path/content into a single CAS loop that also applies the suggestions.jsonl rewrite: either generalize writeIssueFile (alloc.ts:139-214) to accept extra files/removals, or add a variant that re-derives the id + builds both FileWrite entries per CAS attempt and passes [issueFile, penFile] to commitTreeToMain (on-main.ts:404, already supports multiple files + removals in one commit). Do NOT change the dismiss path or the fingerprint-embedding behavior.
gotchas: createLocalIssueOnMain (issue-file.ts:271-318) currently DROPS the filename returned by writeIssueFile; the combine needs the {path, content} of the issue file, so this seam must be widened or bypassed.

Id allocation MUST stay inside the CAS loop (alloc.ts:174-178): naively passing a pre-computed issue path into commitTreeToMain reintroduces id-collision risk, because commitTreeToMain re-reads the tree per attempt but does NOT re-derive an id.
commitTreeToMain already supports multiple files + removals atomically (proven by patterns-archive.ts:236); the atomic primitive exists, the work is threading id re-allocation through it.
Update the two-commit assertions in suggestions.test.ts:630-631 (issueSha=firstco / penSha=secondc) and the :490 comment that says promote fires commit-tree twice.
